name: Mummification Wraps
body:
Aura moderate necromancy; CL 7th; Slot body; Price 28,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These strips of rough linen, decorated with hieroglyphic entreaties to the goddess of death, smell faintly of exotic spices and palm wine.

EFFECTS

Anyone wearing the wraps around her body is healed by negative energy, such as inflict spells and channeled negative energy, as if the effect were composed of positive energy instead. A maximum of 40 hit points per day may be healed in this manner. Positive energy healing effects still affect the wearer as usual. In addition, anyone targeting the wearer with a curse effect must succeed at a caster level check vs. DC 16 or the effect fails.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells death ward; Cost 14,000 gp
